commentary.text: 90+5' Nothing more will happen in this game as the referee blows for full time.
90+4' Yasin Ayari (Brighton) picks up a pass and tries his luck from mid-range low towards the middle of the goal, but Robin Roefs is equal to it and makes an easy save.
90+2' Kaoru Mitoma (Brighton) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
90' 4 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
89' The current number of shots on target for both teams is 14:14.
87' Fabian Hurzeler has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Tom Watson (Brighton) replacing Brajan Gruda.
86' Darren England shows a yellow card to Enzo Le Fee (Sunderland) for his blatant foul.
84' Kaoru Mitoma (Brighton) launches the ball from the resulting corner, but one of the defenders is first to the ball and deals with the threat.
84' Yasin Ayari (Brighton) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away. The ball goes out of play. Brighton are awarded a corner kick.
83' Yasin Ayari (Brighton) receives a clever pass and shoots from mid-range. His shot looks like it's going in the middle of the goal, but Robin Roefs has other ideas and makes a brilliant save.
82' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Brighton.
81' Brajan Gruda (Brighton) takes the free kick but it is cleared by the first defender.
79' Daniel Ballard (Sunderland) has tested the patience of referee Darren England and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
78' Yasin Ayari (Brighton) sends in a shot from a promising distance after a precise pass. His effort goes inches over the crossbar.
77' James Milner (Brighton) creates a yard of space for himself and tries an effort from distance, but it's blocked.
76' Ferdi Kadioglu (Brighton) expertly controls the pass inside the penalty area and shoots, but it's inadvertently blocked a defender.
74' Romaine Mundle (Sunderland) brings his opponent down with a tackle and Darren England blows his whistle for a foul.
72' Regis Le Bris has decided to substitute Brian Brobbey and he is replaced by Wilson Isidor (Sunderland).
71' Here is a change. Yankuba Minteh is going off and Fabian Hurzeler gives the last tactical orders to Charalampos Kostoulas (Brighton).
71' Here's the change. Jack Hinshelwood leaves the pitch and James Milner (Brighton) comes on as a substitute.
71' Kaoru Mitoma (Brighton) shows too much aggression while trying to break free from his opponent and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
69' Kaoru Mitoma (Brighton) robs an opponent of the ball and explodes in anger when Darren England blows for a foul.

67' Romaine Mundle (Sunderland) fashions a shot from the edge of the box after receiving an accurate pass. Bart Verbruggen makes a stunning save to stop the effort from flying into the bottom left corner.
66' Let's have a look at statistics for the fouls committed by both teams – 8:9.
64' Kaoru Mitoma (Brighton) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Maxim De Cuyper.
64' Regis Le Bris has decided to make a change. Habib Diarra (Sunderland) replaces Christopher Rigg.
63' Simon Adingra comes off the pitch to be replaced by Romaine Mundle (Sunderland).
63' A cross into the box from Joel Veltman (Brighton) is cleared.
61' The ball is cleared after Yankuba Minteh (Brighton) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
59' Sunderland are ruled offside.
57' The percentage of ball possession is – 49:51.
55' A wild pass somehow finds Yasin Ayari (Brighton) in space, he steadies himself and shoots from mid-range but sends it just over the bar.
53' Trai Hume (Sunderland) fires the ball on goal, but his attempt goes well wide of the left post.
52' Brian Brobbey (Sunderland) collects a pass inside the box and unleashes a shot which is brilliantly blocked by a defender.
49' Yasin Ayari (Brighton) unleashes a shot, but his effort is poor and floats high over the bar.
47' The corner is swung in but Sunderland can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.

47' Omar Alderete (Sunderland) attempts to convert a cross into a goal, but his promising header from near the penalty spot towards the roof of the net is denied by a decent save from Bart Verbruggen.
46' Fabian Hurzeler has decided to make a substitution during the half-time break. Joel Veltman (Brighton) comes on the pitch for Mats Wieffer.
46' Referee Darren England blows his whistle to start the second half.
45+4' The first half of today's match has just finished.
45+3' This shall not pass! Georginio Rutter (Brighton) lines up a shot from the edge of the box and goes for goal, but the effort is well blocked by a defender.
45+2' A lofted pass into the box is met by Yankuba Minteh (Brighton), who rifles a shot just over the bar.
45' The fourth official shows 3 min. of added time.
45' Brian Brobbey (Sunderland) has time on the edge of the box. His shot is disappointing, though, as it flies towards the middle of the goal where Bart Verbruggen makes a comfortable save.
43' The resulting set piece from Sunderland is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
42' Simon Adingra (Sunderland) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge. Sunderland have been awarded a corner kick.
41' Yankuba Minteh (Brighton) slips past one challenge, but is unable to feed a low pass into the path of one of his teammates.
40' Yankuba Minteh (Brighton) is asking for medical treatment after picking up an injury.
38' Enzo Le Fee (Sunderland) reacts well to get to the rebound and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but he fails to get the ball through the players standing between him and the goal.
36' The resulting set piece, sent into the penalty area by Granit Xhaka (Sunderland), was easily dealt with by one of the defenders.
34' The whistle is blown for an infringement and Diego Coppola (Brighton) receives a yellow card!

32' Daniel Ballard (Sunderland) creates himself some space around the penalty spot and connects with the free kick. His header is aimed towards the middle of the net, but Bart Verbruggen pulls off a comfortable save to thwart him.
32' The referee blows his whistle after Jack Hinshelwood (Brighton) does a good impression of a basketball player and handles the ball.
30' Sunderland are showing great team chemistry. They are passing the ball around seamlessly.
28' The ball possession at the moment is 45:55.
26' Mats Wieffer (Brighton) is able to continue to play.
24' Mats Wieffer (Brighton) picks up an injury.
22' Simon Adingra (Sunderland) changes the direction of the ball using his hand, but he is angry when the referee gives a foul against him.
21' Sunderland will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
21' Simon Adingra (Sunderland) tries to send a pass but it's blocked. Corner kick. Sunderland will have an opportunity.
19' Brajan Gruda (Brighton) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Darren England had an easy-decision to make.
19' Brajan Gruda (Brighton) strikes the ball goalwards from a mid-range free kick, but his effort goes towards the middle of the goal. Not a big deal for the goalkeeper.
17' A run and shot from the edge of the box by Enzo Le Fee (Sunderland) causes Bart Verbruggen little worry as it's towards the middle of the goal. Easy save.
15' Georginio Rutter (Brighton) is well placed to meet a cross and sends a difficult header towards the middle of the goal, but the goalkeeper reacts well to stop the effort.
14' It's a nice effort by Omar Alderete (Sunderland) from the edge of the box, but it's low towards the middle of the goal and straight down the throat of Bart Verbruggen. Easy save.
12' Christopher Rigg (Sunderland) was too forceful with his tackle and Darren England interrupted the game to signal a free kick.
10' Sunderland failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.

9' Trai Hume (Sunderland) attempts to find his teammate with a final pass from outside of the box, but one of the defenders clears the ball to safety. The ball goes out of play. Sunderland are awarded a corner kick.
8' Omar Alderete (Sunderland) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Darren England no option but to blow his whistle.
6' Sunderland are seeing far more of the ball now.

4' Mats Wieffer (Brighton) outjumps the defence to meet the resulting corner and heads the ball towards the top of the net. The long-range header is not powerful enough, and the keeper comfortably makes a save.
3' Maxim De Cuyper (Brighton) goes over to take the corner kick and it looks like he will swing the ball into the penalty box.
1' The first half has just begun.
Sunderland will kick the game off.
